insight: When a SaaS product has both Marketing and Dashboard surfaces and a major aesthetic pivot is requested, recommend staging: Marketing gets the new language first (low data-density tolerates expressive aesthetics), Dashboard migrates separately with adapted tokens (data density requires muted blobs/grain). Document the temporary visual gap as deliberate in DESIGN.md so QA does not flag it as drift.

USD_PER_UNIT in frontend/convex/lib/pricing.ts is read by exactly ONE function (usdToUnits), called from only knowledgeBase.ts:828,894. Nothing converts a wallet balance to dollars anywhere. So changing the dollar value of a unit does NOT revalue any stored balance, ledger row, or UI number — it only changes the COGS-to-units exchange rate for metered actions. Do not plan a wallet migration for it.

backend/src/actvox/workspace_agent/callbacks.py track_complete fires from a PER-NODE context manager (~35 call sites), and convex/agentRuns.ts complete matches on (runId, nodeName). Any billing design that settles on run-complete settles at the FIRST node cost and gets already_settled for the rest. GraphInterrupt also calls track_complete, so approval-gated turns settle pre-approval. Trigger per-turn settlement from the route stream-end instead.

getMemberLimit in frontend/convex/lib/workspaceLimits.ts enforces nothing app-side — there is no member-count throw anywhere. It only writes organizations.maxMembers and pushes it to Clerk max_allowed_memberships via organizations.ts syncClerkMaxMembers. Deleting the map removes zero enforcement; existing orgs stay capped in Clerk until something explicitly raises the ceiling.

In a Convex module, an UNANNOTATED ctx.runQuery/ctx.runMutation into a function defined in the SAME module makes the module type depend on itself. TypeScript breaks the cycle by degrading inference and the damage is project-wide, not local: in research-actvox one such call produced 584 spurious TS7006 implicit-any errors in unrelated test files, with nothing pointing at the new file. Always annotate the result type of a same-module runQuery/runMutation. Bisect trick: a trivial extra convex module gives 0 errors, so if adding a module explodes tsc the cause is inside the file, not the module count.
